name: Data migration and archival
summary: Staff-run data movement: importing a customer's images and videos from another site-capture product, and exporting completed projects' data for external storage with role-based access to archives. Both are PRD-only today.

roles.note: The migration adapter found locally is not a git repository, so no code-backed roles are recorded.

nfr.statement: How long archived project data is kept, and in what form, after a project completes.
nfr.open_question: Which data-retention regulations apply, and how often is the policy reviewed?

requirements.title: Staff import images and videos from another capture product
requirements.statement: The Track3D team can migrate a customer's 360° images, phone images and 360° videos from StructionSite into Track3D. The customer provides a ZIP file (through a file-sharing link or otherwise). Its structure and contents are checked before import.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. A local adapter folder exists but is not a git repository, so it can't be pinned or cited.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Track3D internal tools (control panel, performance monitoring, client discovery, internal notifications, release updates, data migration)

acceptance_criteria.given: A correctly prepared ZIP of 360° images for one project
acceptance_criteria.then: The images appear as captures in the project without errors

acceptance_criteria.given: A ZIP whose folder structure is wrong
acceptance_criteria.then: The import stops and reports what is wrong

requirements.title: Completed projects can be exported and archives are role-protected
requirements.statement: Users can export a completed project's data for storage outside Track3D. Archived project data is readable only by users whose role allows it. Requests made while the system is down are queued.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. The source file is titled client discovery but describes archival. Archiving and restoring projects is bounded by DEC-019.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - Track3D internal tools (control panel, performance monitoring, client discovery, internal notifications, release updates, data migration)
sources.at: client-discovery.md FR-001, FR-002, AC-001, AC-002, EC-001

acceptance_criteria.when: An authorised user exports its data
acceptance_criteria.then: A package of the project's data is produced for external storage

acceptance_criteria.when: A user without an archive-reading role tries to open its data
